entry.description: `SmtpPickupDirAppender` writes MIME headers: `MIME-Version`, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` and `Content-Transfer-Encoding`. The body goes out as `8bit`, or as `base64` when a line exceeds the 998 octets RFC 5322 allows or the layout header or footer holds a NUL. A strict mail server refused the whole mail for one long logged line, and a reader without a charset garbled non-ASCII text. A NUL from logged content is now written as `\0` (ANT-2026-TNHX6V52, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
